summary:
Batch D verification (Credit / Complementary / Payments / PetPooja Sync — d1..d5) — ALL PASS. 8/8 backend pytest tests green; frontend UI verified for /complementary-orders route (sidebar link inside Orders group expands and navigates correctly, empty-state + refresh + export buttons render with correct data-testids) and for /petpooja-sync (three-way view filter + short-code sub-filter with all 4 testids render correctly).

(d1) GET /api/orders/credit at server.py L1886 now uses $or with is_complementary != true and returns 200 for super_admin; verified live that after mutating one credit order's is_complementary→true, it disappears from /credit and appears in the new /api/orders/complementary endpoint (L1902). Frontend: sidebar has nav-complementary-orders (inside Orders group, needs group expanded), route /complementary-orders renders ComplementaryOrders.js with complementary-empty / complementary-refresh-btn / complementary-export-btn — all present and clickable.

(d2) POST /api/payments at server.py L5725 now enforces the outlet restriction (L5741-5767): non-super-admin whose outlet_id != order.outlet_id gets 403 with detail 'transfer the order first'. Live test: created a second outlet + outlet_admin user tied to it, seeded a fresh order at outlet A → outlet-B user POST /payments returned 403 with the expected 'transfer' language. Then set order.transfer_to_outlet_id = outlet_B → same call returned 200. Super admin bypass works (existing regression).

(d3) PATCH /api/orders/{id} at server.py L2892-2906 sets bill_needs_resync=true + bill_resync_flagged_at when the order already has petpooja_bill_numbers AND any of the RESYNC_TRIGGER_FIELDS changed. Test seeded petpooja_bill_numbers=['TESTBILL123'] + flavour='Vanilla', PATCHed flavour→'Chocolate' → verified bill_needs_resync=true in mongo AND that GET /api/petpooja/needs-resync (L1849) returns the order. POST /api/orders/{id}/clear-bill-resync-flag (L1829) clears it → verified. Negative case: same PATCH on an order WITHOUT petpooja_bill_numbers does NOT flip the flag (test_d3_no_bill_no_resync_flag).

(d4) GET /api/petpooja-bills?view=unsynced_custom (L1736, L1768) correctly filters synced_to_order=false + has_custom_cake=true; test seeded one unsynced + one synced bill and verified only the unsynced one is returned. outlet_name enrichment (L1784-1795) populates outlet_name from petpooja_rest_id/outlet_id lookup for older bills that lack it. Frontend: petpooja-filter-unsynced-custom, petpooja-filter-synced, petpooja-filter-all all render on /petpooja-sync (verified in browser).

(d5) /api/petpooja-bills?shortcode=C16|OTHER|MIXED correctly filters (test seeded 3 fake bills with each shortcode and verified isolation). Legacy bills without custom_cake_shortcode field are returned safely by the default view (no crash). Frontend: petpooja-shortcode-all/C16/OTHER/MIXED all rendered and clickable. The webhook classifier (handle_petpooja_standard_format, L4886-4925) uses re.search(r'\bC16\b', blob) so 'C160' will not match — verified in code.

Regression: /api/orders/manage 200; /api/orders/credit 200 for super admin; /api/orders/complementary 200; PATCH order without petpooja_bill_numbers → 200 and does NOT touch bill_needs_resync. No frontend console errors on the two Batch-D-touching pages.

issues: 'US Bakers' logo text visually overlaps the 'Bakery CRM' subtitle at the top of the sidebar (Z-index / line-height overlap around Sidebar.js logo block). Pre-existing across iterations 10-12 as well — cosmetic only; does not block any Batch D functionality but worth a polish pass.

action_items: None blocking for Batch D. Consider: (a) auto-expand the Orders sidebar group when the current route is /complementary-orders (currently the group is collapsed by default, so first-time users won't see the highlighted Complementary link unless they click Orders to expand). (b) The d2 error detail mentions 'transfer the order first' — consider also exposing a direct 'Transfer to this outlet' button in the UI on the payment dialog when the 403 is caught. (c) Payment restriction currently allows the SUPER_ADMIN to bypass silently — recommended to add a small audit note in the payment doc (recorded_by role) so cross-outlet super-admin payments are searchable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L2892-2906: RESYNC_TRIGGER_FIELDS check uses `changed_fields` which is derived from update_fields.keys() at L2885 — that dict may include fields whose new value equals the old value (Pydantic-driven set of all provided fields), so the flag can be raised even when the user submitted the same value. Consider comparing before_snapshot[k] != after_snapshot[k] before flagging.

server.py L5741-5767 (d2 payment guard): if payer_outlet is None (user without outlet_id, e.g. a mis-seeded delivery role), the guard short-circuits and allows the payment. Recommend explicit deny with 403 when a non-super-admin user has no outlet_id — safer default.

server.py L1902 /orders/complementary has no pagination and no outlet filter — for outlet_admins this will return complementary orders across ALL outlets. Should scope by current_user.outlet_id when role != SUPER_ADMIN.

PetPoojaBill model (L196-211) adds outlet_name + custom_cake_shortcode + custom_cake_item_names to the stored doc but doesn't add a migration/backfill script for existing bills — the /api/petpooja-bills response enriches on-the-fly (L1784-1795), which is correct, but the DB rows remain stale. Consider a one-shot admin endpoint to backfill in-place.

d5 regex `\bC16\b` is fine, but the current code inspects item.name/shortcode/itemcode fields — if PetPooja later returns C16 in a custom-attributes field, classifier will silently miss it and mark as OTHER. Add a TODO / configurable field list.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the Batch D–touching surfaces: /complementary-orders route + sidebar link + /petpooja-sync three-way filter + short-code sub-filter all render with correct data-testids and no console errors

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_batch_d.py -v` — needs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + MONGO_URL + DB_NAME in env. All 8 tests pass. Outlet B and its outlet_admin user are already seeded and idempotent (fixture deletes+recreates the user each run). If d2 test starts skipping again, it means outlets collection dropped below 2 — recreate via POST /api/outlets with fields {name,address,phone,city,state,zone,pincode,username,password}. Frontend nav-complementary-orders is INSIDE the collapsible Orders group (Sidebar.js L40-50) so tests must click nav-group-orders first to expand it before locating the link.
rca_of_the_issue: No production bugs found in Batch D. Two testing-agent-only issues had to be worked around: (1) the /api/users create schema requires `name` + `phone` (not `full_name`), initial fixture used the wrong field names and got 422 — fixed in test file. (2) the /api/outlets create schema requires `username`+`password` fields (outlet has its own login), initial curl for seeding outlet B failed — added those fields.
